request.notes: source/destinations are system id64 values, NOT names. destinations is a repeated form key (jQuery traditional:true), one per destination id64. capacity/mass come from carrier type: fleet={capacity:25000,mass:25000}, squadron={capacity:60000,mass:15000}. When calculate_starting_fuel=0 the site also sends fuel_loaded and tritium_stored (ints); when 1 it may send refuel_destinations (repeated id64 key, subset of destinations).
